summary: No record change this cycle. I attempted to revise the snapshot-trigger Fact (1f6e894a67e24249ab6b8dbbcd9e76e3-knowledge-0) so its consequence sentence would stop implying a per-interval recurrence and stop relying on the stored-snapshot count, which source reading of the in-memory and file-backed snapshot stores shows cannot track snapshot attempts (Create replaces the single latest snapshot on the in-memory store and List returns only that one, while the file-backed store reaps by retain count). Validation rejected the correction because a knowledge update may not carry a revision field and the affected-use reference must be revision-qualified in a form this batch did not satisfy; rather than submit an inaccurate or non-conforming revision I left the Fact text untouched and recorded the correction in the update rationale. The defect account is unaffected: the spurious verdict rests on its own witness (store_last=0 against snapshot_index=3 with applied_index=3 and should_snapshot=true, CheckRun a4a0cbfa094b4d1982032d9de0652861, sustained through later samples), and the recorded consequence already carries the withdrawal of the per-interval wording and of the stored-count proxy, with the bound to redundant snapshot work at an unchanged index and no safety effect.
